rows.Origin:
Bred by Meilland International (France).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) in 2005 as 'René Goscinny'.
rows.Bloom: Orange and yellow, vermilion shading. (Orange de tanger clair suffusé vermillon). Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Source: L'Haÿ-les-roses Label. Peach, grapefruit and linden fragrance.
